# Build

The commands `mt help` lists under Build. More in [Projects and deploys](../../../concepts/projects-and-deploys.md).

In a terminal, type `mt` and then the command. In the interactive shell and the cloud shell, type the command on
its own. `mt help <command>` shows the same details in your terminal.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`build`](#build) | Validate a project folder: compile and check every file, and save nothing *(not in the cloud shell)* |
| [`build-delete`](#build-delete) | Delete a build's record from the build history; what it deployed is untouched (tenant admins only) |
| [`build-get`](#build-get) | Show one build or deploy from the build history: who ran it, how it ended, and its compilation log |
| [`build-list`](#build-list) | List recent builds and deploys (the build history), newest first, in a namespace or in every namespace with `--all` |
| [`deploy`](#deploy) | Deploy a project folder: compile and check every file, then save it all to the namespace (tenant admins only; nothing is saved if any file has an error) *(not in the cloud shell)* |

## build

Validate a project folder: compile and check every file, and save nothing.

```text
mt build <path> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<path>` | text | yes |  | The project folder, for example ./maitento |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it reads a project from the local disk, and the cloud shell has none. Use Build studio instead.

## build-delete

Delete a build's record from the build history; what it deployed is untouched (tenant admins only).

```text
mt build-delete <id> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The build's id (from build-list) |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--confirm` | flag |  |  | Delete it; without this the command only shows what would be deleted |

## build-get

Show one build or deploy from the build history: who ran it, how it ended, and its compilation log.

```text
mt build-get <id>
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<id>` | id | yes |  | The build's id (from build-list) |

## build-list

List recent builds and deploys (the build history), newest first, in a namespace or in every namespace with `--all`.

```text
mt build-list [options]
```

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |
| `--all, -a` | flag |  |  | List the builds of every namespace |
| `--outcome, -o <value>` | text |  |  | Only builds that ended this way: Succeeded, Failed or Rejected |
| `--limit, -l <number>` | whole number |  | `20` | Maximum number of builds to list (1-200) |

## deploy

Deploy a project folder: compile and check every file, then save it all to the namespace (tenant admins only; nothing is saved if any file has an error).

```text
mt deploy <path> [options]
```

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `<path>` | text | yes |  | The project folder, for example ./maitento |

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--namespace, -ns <value>` | text |  |  | The namespace to use (default: your default namespace; see ns-get) |

**Not available in the cloud shell:** it reads a project from the local disk, and the cloud shell has none. Use Build studio instead.
